title: Following a pause and its messages
description: You can inspect the order of random selection, notification and resumption.

steps.description: The program imports random-number and sleep facilities. You seed the random generator before requesting a value.
The expression based on rand stores a bounded positive value in sleepTime. You print the selected value before calling sleep.

steps.question: Which call must return before the wake-up message prints?
steps.answer: sleep must return first. The wake-up print follows it in the same main function.

steps.description: You see a sleep announcement followed by The program has woken up. This example demonstrates sequential calls in main without creating a thread.
